topic: Static vs Motion: Why your photos are being ignored

hooks.text: Café owners: Why does a moving photo stop scrolling instantly?
Gym owners: Myth—high‑res photos win. Fact—motion grabs attention.
Shopkeepers: Add a 2‑second loop, watch pause rates rise.
